Download a publication and verify what arrived

Source: R/publications.R
knbs_download_publication.Rd

Downloads one publication file, preserving its official filename, verifying that a document (not an error page) arrived, checksumming it, and writing a <file>.metadata.json provenance sidecar next to it.

Usage

knbs_download_publication(
  publication_id,
  destination = ".",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verify = TRUE,
  sidecar = TRUE,
  source = NULL,
  quiet = knbs_option("quiet")
)

Arguments

publication_id

A publication_id from knbs_publications().

destination

Directory to write into.

overwrite

Whether to replace an existing file of the same name.

verify

Whether to refuse a response that is a web page rather than a document.

sidecar

Whether to write the provenance sidecar.

source

Source id.

quiet

Whether to suppress the progress message.

Value

Invisibly, a one-row tibble describing the download: local_path, download_url, downloaded_at, size_bytes, sha256 and the identifying fields.

See also

knbs_publications() to find identifiers, knbs_cite() to cite what you downloaded.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pubs <- knbs_publications("economic survey", year = 2026)
knbs_download_publication(pubs$publication_id[[1]], "data/publications")
} # }
